FRIENDSHIP_DICE.Rules.Bond: A bond is shared between two characters with a dice formula set by the GM.
FRIENDSHIP_DICE.Rules.Usage: Roll one of your friendship dice and add the result to any check.
FRIENDSHIP_DICE.Rules.Nearby: Your bonded friend must be no more than 10 feet away to use the die.
FRIENDSHIP_DICE.Rules.Limit: Once used, you can't use any friendship die again until you finish a long rest.

FRIENDSHIP_DICE.Settings.RollDialog.Hint: When enabled, a dialog will appear on skill checks, ability checks, saving throws, and attacks offering to add a friendship die. Requires midi-qol. Disable to use only the manual Roll button in the panel.
FRIENDSHIP_DICE.Settings.RollThreshold.H: Only show the friendship die dialog when the d20 result is below this value. Set to 0 to always show the dialog.
